title: Printable Envelopes and Pockets for Junk Journal, Autumn Vintage Envelope Templates, Library Card Pockets, Tags, Belly Bands
description:
Want pretty pockets and envelopes to hide cards, notes and photos in your junk journal? Print these autumn vintage templates, cut, fold and glue.

WHO IT'S FOR
Junk journalers and scrapbookers who love interactive pages with hidden pockets and tuck spots.

WHAT YOU GET: 14 printable pages in US Letter and A4
1. 6 envelope templates in 3 shapes: pointed flap, rounded square and wallet
2. 2 sheets of library card pockets (4 pockets)
3. 2 tuck-in page pockets
4. 1 sheet of 4 tall pocket tags
5. 1 sheet of 4 belly bands
6. 2 START HERE pages with folding tips

That is 20 pieces to cut out. You receive 2 PDF files: one in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and one in A4, high resolution.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Clear guides: solid line to cut, dashed line to fold
- Every template is printed with a matching autumn vintage paper, so no extra paper is needed
- Envelopes and pockets fit 2.5 x 3.5 in journaling cards

HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files from the Purchases section of your Etsy account (use a web browser; the Etsy app does not download digital files)
2. Open the PDF that matches your paper: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) or A4
3. Print at 100% / Actual size on matte paper or light cardstock
4. Cut, fold, layer and create

GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a digital download: nothing is shipped
- Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers
- Personal use and physical handmade items you sell (journals, cards, scrapbooks) are welcome; reselling or sharing the digital files is not
- Some of the artwork was created with the help of AI tools, then selected and finished by hand
- Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is wrong with your files, message me and I'll make it right!

Part of the Ember & Oak autumn collection by Oakfold. Every piece is designed to match.
